title: Minor docs update (after function deprecation)
body: The `find_optimal_cell_shape` function in `doped` has now been deprecated (as the updates in https://gitlab.com/ase/ase/-/merge_requests/3616 make it mostly redundant). This is a small change to remove the link to that function in the tutorial docs.
author: kavanase

comments.author: yuzie007
comments.body: Thank you @kavanase for the doc update!

thread.actionability_reasoning: This is a pure acknowledgment/social comment expressing gratitude. It does not suggest any code change, flag any issue, or imply any modification is needed.
